create_placeholders_from_data_dicts: create placeholders from a list of data dictionaries for graph neural network input
build_data_dicts_to_graphs_tuple: build a GraphsTuple from a list of data dictionaries with node, edge and global features
create_fully_connect_graph_dynamic: create fully connected edges for a GraphsTuple with dynamic node counts per graph
concat_graphs_tuples: concatenate multiple GraphsTuples along a given axis for batching or feature stacking
pad_graphs_tuple: pad a GraphsTuple to fixed sizes for nodes, edges and graphs to enable batching
